text_block_list.text:
The Hanshin JF—
A GⅠ race to determine the best of the Junior Class.
The higher the tier of the race, the higher the level demanded, and the heavier the toll on the body.

For Nishino Flower, who skipped grades and is still physically young,
this race is bound to demand far more from her than her debut did.

To keep fighting in the future, proper care knowledge is vital.
However, as an inexperienced Trainer, I had neither
the knowledge nor the experience. And so—
choice_data_list: Senpai! Looking forward to working with you today!

text_block_list.name: Senior Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
Oh, you're here! I'm all set on my end.
It was about physical conditioning, right?
Here, this is the material I have!

text_block_list.name: Senior Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
Also, I invited some graduates over.
I figured hearing what they used to do might give us some good pointers.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Huh, the person over there is...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: What is it, Flower?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
(Agnes Tachyon-san.
She does lots of difficult research,
and she's very fun to talk to.)

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Ah, umm...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: ...Hmph.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Flower-kun, the truth is, about my lab coat...
Due to various circumstances, it's currently reduced to a tattered rag.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
It's a pitiful sight to behold, and even worse to wear.
Would you mind taking a look at it for me?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes.
I'll do my best...!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: ――Hyah...!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: *wheeze*... *gasp*...!

"We cranked up the training intensity in preparation for the GⅠ.
As a result, Nishino Flower began experiencing deep exhaustion even during regular practice."

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Ah, yes...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
...!
Th-Thank... you...

What I learned from my senpai has helped with her care.
However, I still feel like I lack a fundamental
understanding of her needs...

On yet another day.
While looking into Umamusume anatomy to deepen my understanding further—
—That literature isn't appropriate.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Rather, I believe your priority right now
should be trial and error, not arm-chair theorizing.
In other words, practical fieldwork.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"Agnes Tachyon, just a humble Umamusume.
Pardon the abruptness, but day in and day out—
I study the Umamusume 'physique.'"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Hmm, just as I thought.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
You must be Flower's Trainer.
She's been taking very good care of me, you know.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"As your senior, if there's anything I can do to help,
I want to do it all for you.
From the bottom of my heart! Purely out of good will!"
choice_data_list: I'd love to hear your story!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Leave it to me. I shall lend my knowledge
to lighten Flower-kun's burden—*specifically* hers.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: By the way, my cooperation comes with a simple condition. No, it's nothing major, I just need you to drink a certain beverage and do some "light" exercise.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer,
you're taking so long...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
(The person she was talking to earlier...
That was Senpai's Trainer, right?)
"Because I'm still far from experienced."
"Because I'm still so inexperienced."

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: (Could it be... you've been studying hard again for my sake?)

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
(Because I'm still just a little kid...
...It must be really tough on Trainer.)

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Sorry to keep you waiting, Flower-kun.
He got a little carried away, you see.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Sorry to keep you waiting, Flower-kun.
She got a little carried away, you see.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
"Trainer, what's going on!?
And wait, why is Tachyon-san here too...?"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Well, there was a slight misunderstanding.
I merely wanted to increase my sample size to see how a certain ingredient affects cardiopulmonary function.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: In short, it was just a light motion test. But he came to a wonderful, delightfully mistaken conclusion—thinking, 'The harder I work, the more feedback I'll get!'

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: In short, it was just a light motion test. But she came to a wonderful, delightfully mistaken conclusion—thinking, 'The harder I work, the more feedback I'll get!'

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu, thanks to you, we got truly meaningful results!
Naturally, I threw in some extra advice for little Flower as well!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
...!
For my sake...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
And so, the two of you can handle the trial and error
from here. I shall return to my research.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Right. Consider my debt for the lab coat repaid.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: ...I'm sorry.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
"Because it's all my fault...
I'm making things so hard for you, Trainer."

It seems she got the idea that her "body" is causing a burden.
Granted, it may be an unusual case. But...
choice_data_list: I'm happy I get to work so hard for you
I'm happy I get to work hard for you!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I...
I completely... understand that feeling.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: ...All right.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, please take a rest.
I'll go get some water.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I'll go run right after that!
Just you watch!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Haaaaah...!

Nishino Flower showed amazing sharpness down the final straight.
She's grown even more since yesterday's training...!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa...!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Haa, thank you very much...
choice_data_list: Did you do some secret training or something?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
No.
It is just...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Knowing that you're working hard too, Trainer,
somehow gave me a surge of strength!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Yes... That seems to be the case.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Your hard work, Trainer,
is what helps me grow so much.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for putting your heart into it.
I felt every bit of it!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: It's not just you who's working hard, Trainer, I want to do my best too. That's why...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: "Could you tell me what you learned today?"

Her first GⅠ brings great anxiety. But...
as long as I'm with Nishino Flower,
we can definitely run through it!
